A few comments before you get started:

You might notice that there’s two instances of currency and currency per second. (One called entropy and another called currency (which you should rename later)) This is for the abbreviator. The entropy variables are the raw number and are what the scripts use to function. The numbers are fed into the cash abbreviator sprite, which shortens them to make them easier to understand. I need a separate variable because if a variable contains any letters (besides e), it will be interpreted as 0.

This is a STARTER project. It’s more simple than my games and is missing some features. I want this template to be as easy to understand as possible, and am planning on making an advanced version later with all of the necessary sprites.

If any Boolean (white circle) is blank within a sprite, that means that YOU have to put a number in there. Depending on the scenario it will one of a few things
The name
The cost
The X and Y positions
The production (only for generators)

This project will be reshared many times. If you see this, that is becuase I made a beneficial change to the template

And finally, delete this sprite to make the project work (behind this comment is a script that instantly stops the project as soon as the green flag is clicked)
